# Oclean Official

> > Oclean is a leading provider of smart electric toothbrushes and oral care devices featuring advanced Maglev motor technology, AI-powered guidance, and comprehensive brushing tracking.

Oclean's EU store offers a complete range of sonic toothbrushes from premium models like the X Ultra 20 with Maglev 4.0 motor and AI voice guidance to budget-friendly options, plus accessories and kids' models. All products feature waterproof IPX7 design, long battery life, and smart tracking capabilities.

## Key Topics

- Sonic Toothbrush
- Maglev Motor
- AI Voice Guidance
- Smart Toothbrush
- IPX7 Waterproof
- Type-C Charging
- Maglev 4.0 Motor
- Battery Life
- Brushing Tracking
- DuPont Bristles
- Quiet Technology
- Portable Design
- Oral Care
- Electric Toothbrush

## Premium Sonic Toothbrushes

- [Oclean X Ultra 20 Sonic Toothbrush](https://eu.oclean.com/products/x-ultra-20-sonic-toothbrush): Flagship model with Maglev 4.0 motor, AI voice guidance, and advanced smart features
- [Oclean X Pro 20 Sonic Toothbrush](https://eu.oclean.com/products/x-pro-20-sonic-toothbrush): Smart toothbrush with Aurora AI, 32 intensity levels, and comprehensive brushing tracking
- [Oclean X Pro Elite Sonic Toothbrush](https://eu.oclean.com/products/x-pro-elite-sonic-toothbrush): Premium model featuring Maglev motor and DuPont bristles for superior cleaning
- [Oclean X Pro Sonic Toothbrush](https://eu.oclean.com/products/x-pro-sonic-toothbrush): Smart screen toothbrush with Maglev motor and 30-day battery life
